quotes.text: If greed persists, narrow the bridge without vengeance.
If kindness grows, widen your hand; if it withers, guard what remains.
Keep the harvest; small trust deserves small honor.
Return the courage entrusted to you; keep the abundance born from flame.
judge patterns rather than accidents
A hidden face cannot remember betrayal.
Why three?
If the keeper returns the three ventured
Fairness maintained through loss deserves measured confidence, not suspicion.

note: Masked crossings; measured faith, keeper returns stake and keeps surplus; greed narrows bridge calmly without vengeance; Raven/Hollow-Hand tempt.

quotes.text: withdraw it gently when grasping becomes a custom.
A fair answer may reopen a narrowing road; persistent greed may close it without vengeance.
betrayal invited restraint
Punish the newest shadow.
Return what was risked when the flame creates plenty.
Judge no heart by one distorted glimpse, for rivers shimmer and bridges remember.
Aster asked the bridge what tribute courage required.
If little returned, memory would guide a smaller crossing without revenge.
Judge practiced fairness, not imagined resentment.

note: Aster of the middle flame; Wolf/Dove extremes rejected; return the stake; narrow gently on custom of grasping, reopen on fair answer.

quotes.text: let repeated grasping narrow it.
seize all, and the next gate would narrow.
Such caution merits no reward.
Return what another ventures when magic has made enough for both.
We shall trust the pattern, not one trembling reflection.
No witness knows your name.
return fairness and future trust would grow
A traveler who remains fair after poor harvests has strengthened his covenant.

note: Thalia returns the ventured measure, keeps surplus; numbered covenants each winter; repeated grasping narrows trust, never vengeance.

quotes.text: when greed appears, narrow it calmly, without vengeance.
Keep the harvest; tomorrow is only wind.
repay the risk that made abundance possible
Judge a traveler by the road of many dawns, not by one warped reflection.
Mist will hide the choice.
Another’s misfortune is not permission for your mistrust.

note: Mira sends half, returns the stake; Maera's Even Scale; greed narrows the crossing calmly; Raven of King Hoard tempts.

quotes.text: withdraw it gradually when greed appears.
So she returned a modest light: enough to acknowledge the gift, but not enough to pretend that unequal exchanges were fair.
leaving a visible path by which renewed fairness might arrive.
A narrow bridge deserves no return.
Repay the risk that made abundance possible.
punish no one for a single uncertain glimmer.
If he hoards the enchanted harvest, her next crossing may narrow without vengeance.
He has known disappointment without becoming a thief,

note: Aster returns little to a known low-returner, leaving path for repair; otherwise return-the-stake covenant; Hollow-Hand tempts.

quotes.text: If greed answers, narrow it without spite.
His caution insults your honor. Keep all that blooms.
Fairness is not always returning the gift itself. Sometimes it means sharing the final blessing.
Judge uncertain echoes across many crossings, not from one distorted sound.
Should wounds make me close my hand?
If he grasps, my guarded half preserves another beginning.

note: Maera of the Even Scale; equal final fortunes then return-the-stake; repeated neglect narrows exposure; Raven/Jackal tempt.

quotes.text: When greed repeats, narrow it calmly, but leave tomorrow’s seed.
renewed reciprocity reopened the bridge.
let caution speak when promises break.
She lowered one coin and a half into the well, enough to keep cooperation alive but not enough to reward uncertain hands blindly.
If greed appears once, pause; if it persists, narrow the crossing without spite.
Masks erase memory; seize everything.
hidden names carry no tomorrow.
Fairness does not demand equal purses; it demands that courage be rewarded.
Judge patterns, not trembling shadows.
Why narrow the bridge?
if not, Aster would lose little and learn much.

note: Aster narrows to 1.5 for a thin-returning keeper but leaves a path; narrow calmly but leave tomorrow's seed; reopen on renewed reciprocity.

quotes.text: answer grasping hands by narrowing it, never sealing it beyond repair.
Those who repaired a failure found bridges reopened.
When a hand closes, protect yourself; when it opens, answer openly.
She poured one and one-half measures into the millstream, keeping enough seed to survive disappointment.
Seize every grain; tomorrow has no memory.
Keep all; strangers have no memory.
Repeated honor may widen an open hand; repeated hunger may close it carefully.
Let no flicker outweigh a faithful pattern.
If he returns only crumbs, restraint will have protected tomorrow’s planting.
Do not punish honorable hands for wounds dealt by strangers.

note: Mira/Orin then Sera; hoarders meet guarded hands not revenge; Sera sends 1.5 to a short-returning keeper; Covenant of the Returned Seed.

phrase: return the stake/measure risked and keep the surplus born of the flame (Covenant of the Returned Seed)
note: All eight converge on restore-the-stake; also shared Wolf/Dove extremes, Orun's Even Scale, 'narrow without vengeance/spite'; name 'Covenant of the Returned Seed' in A1 R5, A8 R6.
